company.name: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries
company.summary: A pharmaceutical company spanning specialty medicines, generics and consumer healthcare.
company.description: Sun Pharma develops, manufactures and markets pharmaceutical products across chronic and acute therapies. Its portfolio includes specialty medicines, generics, branded generics, over-the-counter products and active pharmaceutical ingredients.
company.money: Revenue comes from selling medicines and pharmaceutical ingredients across markets. Product approvals, competition, pricing, manufacturing quality and research spending shape profit and cash flow.
company.ownership: This profile covers Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited and its consolidated group. A medicine sold by a subsidiary can sit within the group, while a distributed or licensed product may involve another owner.
watch: How much growth comes from specialty products, generics and different markets?
Are development investments producing approved products?
Are manufacturing sites meeting the standards of each market?
risks: Quality failures can lead to warnings, recalls or sales restrictions.
Generic medicine prices can fall when competitors enter.
Development spending does not guarantee approval or commercial success.
update: Products are broader than familiar OTC brands
The official portfolio spans specialty, generic and active-ingredient businesses across many countries.
company.question: Why can a medicine company spend on research without generating a successful new product?
company.answer: Drug development and approval are uncertain. A project can fail scientifically, commercially or during regulatory review.
company.productNote: Major official brand, product and business-offering families reviewed in October 2026. This groups variants, pack sizes, models, formulations or service subtypes where listing each one would obscure the company overview.
